Meta-adaptation is most stable when the learning rate α is between **3e−5 and 5e−4**, i.e. α ∈ [3×10⁻⁵, 5×10⁻⁴] (**page 3**, Section 4.5 "Ablation Study", "Learning Rate" item).

- **What α is:** the paper defines α as the inner-loop learning rate in its meta-learning optimization procedure (**page 2**).
- **Above the range:** the paper says higher learning rates destabilize gradient flow across tasks (**page 3**).

The formula in that sentence is badly typeset in the paper itself. Both the PDF and its text layer show leftover LaTeX next to the formula (`\alphaα`, `\ in [3e^{-5}, 5e^{-4}]`). The range still reads clearly as 3e−5 to 5e−4 in all three places it appears.
